subject.title: fix(sessions): reconcile client-abandoned running sessions on restart

question: Is the proposed lifecycle-generation contract sufficiently proven by a real in-process gateway restart before this session-recovery change is merged?
rationale: The patch changes process-global owner liveness across restart recovery, queue routing, and abortability; unit coverage is valuable but cannot by itself establish the actual restart ordering and signal path.

options.title: Require restart proof
options.body: Request a redacted terminal transcript, runtime logs, or recording showing an abandoned prior-generation session becomes failed after restart while a current replacement session remains live.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the targeted generation and recovery tests if maintainers judge the real restart path adequately represented by the test harness.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle review
options.body: Hold the PR until an owner of gateway lifecycle and session recovery confirms the intended cross-registry liveness contract.

recommendation.title: Require restart proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted terminal transcript, runtime logs, or recording showing an abandoned prior-generation session becomes failed after restart while a current replacement session remains live.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidenced person connected to the proposed lifecycle-generation design and are assigned to this PR; current-main history ownership was unavailable.
